title: Remove dead DuplicateCompletionException / InvalidTrackOperationException or wire them up — neither is thrown in production
rule: AG-6 dead-code (Fowler speculative generality) + secondary EH-5 (hardcoded English userMessage)

evidence.quote: // Tests for DuplicateCompletionException — covers toString and userMessage.

why: Repo-wide grep (lib/ and test/) shows DuplicateCompletionException is referenced nowhere outside its own definition file and its own single-purpose test file; InvalidTrackOperationException is thrown nowhere in lib/ — track_repository.dart only re-exports the type 'so existing importers of this file don't need updating,' and completion_writer.dart's current duplicate-completion handling is idempotent (silently returns the existing row, no exception thrown), confirming both exceptions' original call sites were refactored away. Both classes also bake a raw, hardcoded English message rather than a stable code (DuplicateCompletionException.userMessage is explicitly documented as 'for display in snackbars/dialogs') — if either is revived by a future feature without noticing this, it reintroduces an EH-5 violation (unlocalized English shown to Hebrew-locale users) on day one. Today the risk is purely maintenance/documentation drift: a developer debugging track-deactivation or completion-marking who searches for these classes' names will be misled into thinking they're live guards.
recommendation: Delete both classes and duplicate_completion_exception_test.dart, or wire them into a live call site. If a real duplicate-completion/invalid-track-operation UI error is still needed, add a stable enum/code to a new exception rather than reviving these hardcoded-English ones.
acceptance_criteria: grep for DuplicateCompletionException/InvalidTrackOperationException across lib/ shows either a live throw+catch pair or zero results
No orphaned test file whose only coverage is a dead exception's string formatting
